sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 483 x 232 x 44.5 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

d&b DS20 datasheet, opened 2026-11-12 (read as text): 1 RU x 19 in x 232 mm, drawing 483 x 44.5 x 232 mm, 2 AES3 inputs (4 channels), 8 AES3 outputs (16 channels), built-in 5-port Ethernet switch on etherCON (the number of physical jacks is NOT stated), powerCON mains connector (colour not stated). The datasheet gives no panel per connector. Beta-modelled: the Bêta proposal ports are kept exactly (2 of the 8 AES3 outputs listed; no network port in the proposal although the sheet describes an AVB switch), because the connector set is not fully documented (etherCON count) and a Bêta row must keep its proposal ports. No controls. Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened. Connector genders not stated by the source follow the convention input = female, output = male.
